info.title: PostGrip Service API
info.description: Tenant-scoped service inventory, deployment, runtime control, and revision-fenced service administration.

get.description: Lists tenant-scoped application groupings. catalogEtag and the equivalent response ETag header contain the current Service catalog fence for createServiceApp.

ETag.description: Current Service catalog fence for collection mutations.

post.description: Creates a tenant-scoped application grouping. If-Match must contain the catalog ETag returned by listServiceApps.

put.description: Replaces the application name and description using the application ETag returned by getServiceApp.

delete.description: Deletes only the grouping record. Attached projects and target services are retained and atomically detached by setting their appId to null.

200.description: Service application deleted and attached services detached

get.summary: Resolve an exact service reference, ID, or name
Get a service and its capabilities
Get last-known service and environment status
Resolve an exact service environment ID or name

post.summary: Preview and fence a multi-project release
post.description: Validates the complete dependency graph, exact revisions or artifacts, worker placement, current deployments, environment versions, verification policy, and overlap fences without dispatching work. Independent dependency-ready members form an explicit parallel group.

parameters.name: projectId
parameters.description: Only return release groups containing this project.

post.summary: Create a fenced multi-project release saga
post.description: Accepts an unexpired preview and creates one durable release identity. Dependency-ready members dispatch in parallel. A required failure cancels safe work and restores already-cut-over reversible members; non-reversible cutovers report intervention-required.

get.summary: Get aggregate and per-member release state

post.summary: Cancel and compensate a release group
post.description: Cancels undispatched and still-queued members, waits for unsafe-to-cancel members, and restores every reversible member that cut over.

post.summary: Retry a safely recovered release group
post.description: Retries the same pinned revisions only after compensation or cancellation reached a safe terminal state. Intervention-required groups require a new preview.

post.summary: Probe a target or deployed service

get.summary: Resolve a deploy request to an immutable commit

post.summary: Queue a deployment for a confirmed commit
Queue a deployment from an existing immutable revision
Queue rollback to a historical service deployment
Start the exact current service runtime
Stop the exact current service runtime
Restart the exact current service runtime

patch.description: Updates project configuration. Setting defaultWorkerId or setting clearDefaultWorker=true additionally requires services:admin.

get.description: Returns the latest bounded public DNS, TLS, route, and HTTP observation for the configured domain. This evidence is separate from runtime readiness.

post.description: Performs a bounded HTTPS request to the saved tenant domain only, persists deployment- and configuration-version-bound observations, and advances domain verification and route state when the target is still current.

200.description: Bounded repositories visible through the tenant GitHub App installation

post.description: Refreshes the repository credential on the service's assigned Workers. `webhook-signing` generates a new webhook signing secret. `source-access` issues a new token from the GitHub installation the project is bound to and never replaces a supplied credential: a Worker whose credential is supplied is skipped and sent nothing, and its target in the staged configuration operation is `succeeded` with `errorCode` `CREDENTIAL_SOURCE_SUPPLIED`. When no Worker can be refreshed from an installation and at least one was skipped because its credential is supplied, which is every Worker when the project is not bound to an installation, the request fails with `409` `CREDENTIAL_SOURCE_SUPPLIED` and stages no operation. A supplied credential is refreshed by resubmitting it with putServiceRepositoryCredential.

409.description: Conflict. `CREDENTIAL_SOURCE_SUPPLIED`: `credentialKind` is `source-access`, no Worker can be refreshed from a GitHub installation, and at least one Worker's credential is supplied (every Worker's, when the project is not bound to an installation). No configuration operation is staged; resubmit the credential with putServiceRepositoryCredential to refresh it. Other conflicts on this route, such as `SERVICE_STATE_CHANGED` and `SERVICE_OPERATION_NOT_SUPPORTED`, also use this status.

get.summary: List PostGrip Configuration Stack Operation Actions

get.description: Returns the domain-version- and generation-fenced canonical target independently of the environment primary-domain display preference.
Lists immutable derived DNS plans and their propagation, verification, rollback, or intervention state.

post.description: Derives an exact CNAME or address record plus ownership TXT proof from a tenant-owned configured hostname and current ready release. The caller cannot submit arbitrary record names, types, or targets.

get.description: Returns one immutable DNS plan including current observation, desired records, last-verified rollback records, and safe failure detail.

post.description: Binds an opaque provider/account/zone identity and releases only the immutable derived record set after the target route and every state fence pass. Provider credentials are never accepted.
Accepts an observed result only when it reports every derived record exactly once and contains no extra mutation. Successful reports enter bounded propagation and public verification.

Creates an immutable rollback plan from the last publicly verified record set. If that target is no longer current and ready, the operation reports intervention-required instead of inventing a recovery target.

get.description: Returns approved endpoints and bounded health threshold, hysteresis, cooldown, attempt, TTL, and propagation settings.

put.description: Configures only tenant-owned current-ready endpoint identities. Enabled policies require distinct Workers and never accept provider credentials.

post.description: Creates a fenced failover or failback plan for an explicitly approved endpoint. External apply remains separate and DNS TTL means the result is never reported as instantaneous global cutover.

get.description: Lists branches visible through the tenant's connected GitHub App installation without exposing installation credentials.
Checks whether a repository file exists at an optional ref through the tenant's connected GitHub installation.
Downloads the browser-check screenshot captured by the Worker for an exact tenant-owned deployment.
Lists the bounded recent decisions produced while dispatching GitHub push and pull-request events for a service.
Returns the Worker-held Compose override for an exact service environment.

put.description: Validates and replaces the Worker-held Compose override. This administrative operation can materially change workload execution.

delete.description: Deletes the Worker-held Compose override so the next read or deployment can restore generated defaults.

get.description: Returns saved non-secret values from the assigned Worker. Secret values are represented only by metadata and are never returned.
Returns traffic telemetry status from every Worker assigned to the project or selected environment.
Returns bounded traffic time-series and breakdown data from every assigned Worker.

put.description: Updates project-scoped traffic collection and retention settings on every assigned Worker.

post.description: Deletes traffic rollups older than the configured retention window on every selected Worker.
Deletes all project or selected-environment traffic rollups on every selected Worker.

postgripToken.description: Tenant-scoped PostGrip management token carrying concrete Agent, Worker, and Service grants.

OptionalEnvironment.name: environment
OptionalEnvironment.description: Resolved environment UUID. When omitted, the operation covers every assigned environment in the project.

reversible.description: Set false for stateful members that must never be silently rolled back. A cutover followed by group failure then reports intervention_required.

errorDetail.description: Safe bounded release detail; Worker errors and secrets are not exposed.

cutoverState.description: The deployment's role in the production cutover lifecycle. A candidate is building but cannot receive traffic, cutover is ready and switching, rollback_candidate is an explicit rollback that is queued or building and cannot receive traffic, rollback_cutover is an explicit rollback whose target is ready and switching, live is the routed deployment, retained is the one last known-good rollback target, historical is a completed deployment whose runtime is not retained, and terminal is an incomplete deployment that is neither routed nor retained.

defaultWorkerId.description: Eligible project-level Worker override used for future environment placement when assignedWorkerId is omitted.
Sets the eligible project-level Worker override. This placement change additionally requires services:admin.

clearDefaultWorker.description: Clears the project Worker default so future environments return to automatic placement. Setting this to true additionally requires services:admin.

assignedWorkerId.description: Explicit placement override. When omitted, the project default or deterministic automatic placement is used.

volumes.description: Worker-scoped ephemeral bind mounts. The server derives tenant/project/environment-scoped storage paths from containerPath; Worker-local paths are never accepted or returned.
Replaces the environment's Worker-scoped ephemeral bind mounts. This field requires services:admin.

ServiceAppDeletionResponse.description: Deletion result for a grouping whose attached projects and target services are retained and detached.

ServiceAutomaticDeploymentWiring.description: Last reconciled state of push-triggered automatic deployment wiring. Credential presence alone does not imply that the provider can reach or is configured to call PostGrip.

reason.description: Stable audit reason for the resolved placement decision.

canonicalDnsDomainIds.description: Canonical DNS domains whose active or recoverable target blocks this removal until it is reconciled.

errorCode.description: Machine-readable code for the target's outcome, normally set when the target failed or is blocked. A `succeeded` target of a `repository-credential-refresh` operation with `CREDENTIAL_SOURCE_SUPPLIED` is a Worker skipped because its `source-access` credential is supplied: it was sent nothing and kept that credential.

outputDir.description: Static build output directory relative to the repository's configured projectPath. Empty values use the imperative default; non-empty values cannot be absolute, resolve to the project workspace root, or traverse parent directories. Static deployments require build in WORKER_CAPABILITIES and WORKER_UNSAFE_HOST_BUILDS_ENABLED=true on the assigned Worker.

deploymentMode.description: Static mode is supported only for web projects whose framework does not require Docker.

allowRemoval.description: Explicitly authorizes removal of stack-owned projects and environments that are absent from the manifest. Requires prune=true.

removalDataDisposition.description: Required when an explicitly removed project or environment has managed volumes. The selected disposition is fenced into the immutable plan.

ServiceEphemeralVolumeMount.description: Public projection of a Worker-scoped ephemeral mount. Worker-local storage paths are intentionally omitted.

value.description: Present only for variables explicitly marked non-secret.
